definitions.explanation: Having many layers, levels, or components stacked or combined together. Used as a prefix or modifier to describe things with multiple overlapping elements.

examples.japanese: {多重|たじゅう}⟦{債務|さいむ}→債務：06578_saimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧。
{多重|たじゅう}⟦{録音|ろくおん}→録音：05107_rokuon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧。
examples.english: To layer sounds with multitrack recording.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多重|たじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要因|よういん}→要因：05581_youin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{絡|から}み{合|あ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Multiple factors are intertwined in this problem.

notes:
Composed of {多|た} (many) and {重|じゅう} (layers, overlap). Primarily used as a modifier in compound words to indicate multiple overlapping instances of something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多重|たじゅう}⟦{債務|さいむ}→債務：06578_saimu⟧ — multiple debts (a serious financial/social issue)
- {多重|たじゅう}⟦{人格|じんかく}→人格：11427_jinkaku⟧ — multiple personality
- {多重|たじゅう}⟦{録音|ろくおん}→録音：05107_rokuon⟧ — multitrack recording
- {多重|たじゅう}⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧ — multi-layered structure
- {多重|たじゅう}⟦{下請|したう}け→下請け：10898_shitauke⟧ — multi-layered subcontracting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{二重|にじゅう}→二重：16893_nijuu⟧ — double, twofold; specifically two layers
- {三重|さんじゅう} — triple, threefold; specifically three layers
- ⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧ — plural, multiple; counts distinct items rather than layers
- ⟦{複合|ふくごう}→複合：14114_fukugou⟧ — composite, compound; emphasizes combination of different elements
